answer_text: Design verification MC - requires ngspice simulation to determine actual failing specs

choices.A: Phase margin is insufficient for stability
choices.B: Power consumption exceeds the maximum limit
choices.D: DC gain is below the minimum requirement
choices.E: Cutoff frequency is outside the tolerance range
choices.F: Center frequency deviates from target by >10%
choices.H: Quality factor Q is too low
choices.I: Passband gain does not meet the target
